opportunities.name: Rappel spider boxer
opportunities.objective: Test rappel spider boxer against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Spider Queen gives Elise's own attacks 0.15 AP magic damage and 0.08 AP healing; spider W grants a three-second attack-speed burst. Rappel's descent amplifies the passive for five seconds, so Nashor and Dusk and Dawn test a sustained landing window.
opportunities.requiredState: Descend on the target with spider W available.
opportunities.failure: Short buff duration and squishy melee exposure can lose to normal burst.
opportunities.test: Count Elise's own attacks and healing separately from spiderlings.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Spiderlings do not automatically inherit Nashor or Spellblade; Rappel amplification dispatch needs confirmation.

opportunities.name: Cocoon drain tank
opportunities.objective: Test cocoon drain tank against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Human Q scales current-health magic damage and spider Q scales missing health with AP; Liandry covers the long exchange between forms. Riftmaker and Visage support Elise's own spider healing, while Rocketbelt closes distance after Cocoon without assigning item effects to pets.
opportunities.requiredState: Switch forms to use both Q health curves and keep spider attacks landing.
opportunities.failure: Poor burst delays kills and her defenses remain conditional.
opportunities.test: Compare two full form cycles against one burst rotation at equal gold.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Percentage monster caps and symbolic form tooltips prohibit extrapolating uncapped epic damage.

ruledOut.reason: Spiderlings do not automatically inherit Nashor or Spellblade; Rappel amplification dispatch needs confirmation.

unknowns: Item and ability proc attribution requires a controlled current-patch test; symbolic statFormula and source flags are not runtime verification.

testPlan: Required state: Descend on the target with spider W available.
Count Elise's own attacks and healing separately from spiderlings.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Short buff duration and squishy melee exposure can lose to normal burst.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Spiderlings do not automatically inherit Nashor or Spellblade; Rappel amplification dispatch needs confirmation.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Riftmaker, Bloodletter's Curse, Spirit Visage, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula: Human Form: Elise fires a cocoon, Stunning and revealing the first enemy hit for [1.6 / 1.8 / 2 / 2.2 / 2.4] seconds.
Human Form: Elise summons an explosive spider that moves to a location and explodes when it nears an enemy or after 3 seconds. The spider deals @spell.EliseHumanW:TotalDamage@ magic damage.
Human Form: Elise transforms into a menacing spider, becoming melee, gaining access to Spider Form Abilities and summons all dormant Spiderlings.

Elise begins the game with a point in her Ultimate, allowing her to shapeshift between Human Form and Spider Form.

Human Form: Elise's Ability hits grant her a dormant Spiderling, up to @spell.EliseR:BaseSpiderlingsStored@.

Spider Form: Attacks deal an additional @spell.EliseR:PassiveTotalDamage@ magic damage and restore @spell.EliseR:PassiveTotalHealing@ Health.
